summary_en: Develops an analytical wavenumber-domain framework for predicting spatial resolution in near-field acoustic beamforming, where spherical-wave curvature invalidates conventional far-field Rayleigh estimates. The derived formula explicitly relates resolution to range, frequency, aperture, steering-vector choice, and array geometry, and is validated by simulations and anechoic-chamber source-imaging experiments.
